g.text: When systemd considers the service started. simple: right after fork;
exec: once the binary runs; forking: when the parent exits; oneshot:
when the process exits; dbus: when BusName= appears on the bus;
notify: when it sends READY=1; idle: like simple, after other jobs
simple, exec, forking, oneshot, dbus, notify, notify-reload,
parent exits; oneshot: when the process exits; dbus: when BusName= appears on the bus; notify: when it sends READY=1;
